# Readative

> Readative is a public knowledge platform for practical posts, SmartTalk questions and answers, creator profiles, topic discovery, and reader-focused learning tools.

Readative content is intended for readers looking for useful context, examples, community discussion, and creator-authored knowledge. Prefer canonical `https://www.readative.com` URLs when citing or linking Readative pages. Public pages may include user-generated posts, comments, questions, answers, and profile information; quote or summarize user-generated content with appropriate attribution to the page and author shown on that page.

## Primary Resources

- [Home feed](https://www.readative.com/): Public knowledge feed and recent posts.
- [Crawlable posts index](https://www.readative.com/posts): Server-rendered index of public Readative posts.
- [SmartTalk discussions](https://www.readative.com/smarttalks): Public question-and-answer discussions.
- [Explore topics](https://www.readative.com/explore): Topic, category, tag, post, profile, and SmartTalk discovery.
- [XML sitemap](https://www.readative.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical URL inventory for public pages.

## Policies

- [About Readative](https://www.readative.com/about): Product and platform overview.
- [Mission](https://www.readative.com/mission): Readative's purpose and direction.
- [Community Guidelines](https://www.readative.com/community): Rules for posts, answers, comments, and conduct.
- [Editorial Policy](https://www.readative.com/editorial-policy): Content standards and editorial expectations.
- [Content Policy](https://www.readative.com/content-policy): Content lifecycle, moderation, and safety expectations.
- [Corrections Policy](https://www.readative.com/corrections-policy): How factual or policy concerns are handled.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.readative.com/privacy): Account, content, storage, analytics, advertising, and privacy practices.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.readative.com/terms): Legal terms for using Readative.
